photo.title: Tips for photographing documents
photo.camera.1: For an A4 page use about 5 megapixels; the minimum is 2 megapixels.
photo.camera.3: Use manual aperture, if the camera allows it.
photo.camera.4: Use manual focus, if the camera allows it.
photo.camera.5: Turn on stabilization or use a tripod.
photo.camera.6: Use optical zoom, not digital zoom.
photo.light.1: The light should be strong and even; natural light is best.
photo.light.2: Use two light sources to avoid shadows.
photo.light.3: Do not use the flash on glossy paper.
photo.light.4: In poor light, shoot from about 50 cm.
photo.position.1: Hold the camera parallel to the page.
photo.position.3: The lines may be tilted by at most 20 degrees.
photo.position.4: Focus on the center of the page.
photo.position.6: Use the self-timer, even on a tripod.
photo.blurry: A blurry photo can be corrected with the Photo Correction tool in the Image Editor.
warning.copy_mismatch: The copied text does not seem to match the image. Check the recognition languages or replace the document's text layer, then copy again.
